description: The most fluid and beautiful news reader on Windows 8! Now support merging feed tiles! * Smooth and fluid UI. Designed and now optimized for Surface RT! * Aggregates news from multiple feeds into one tile! * Seamlessly roam feed tiles to other machines * Fully support portrait mode and snapping * Beautiful magazine view * Full interaction with touch, mouse, and keyboard "News Bento ?? The Best News Reader App in the Store" -- McAkins Online News Bento has been recommended by Forbes, CNET, TechRadar, RedmondPie as Essential app for your Surface!
